target: For every generalized Cartan matrix over C, the Serre ideal equals the maximal Cartan-disjoint ideal in the preliminary contragredient Lie algebra.

opened_primary_results.source: Marquis, Around the Lie correspondence for complete Kac-Moody groups and Gabber-Kac simplicity
opened_primary_results.claim: Introduction distinguishes characteristic-zero Lie-algebra Gabber-Kac theorem and says the nonsymmetrizable case remains completely open. Positive-characteristic group counterexamples are not counterexamples to this target.

opened_primary_results.source: Gorelik, Hinich, Serganova, Root groupoid and related Lie superalgebras
opened_primary_results.claim: Section1.1.3 distinguishes the exact two classical constructions; says symmetrizable agreement is known and root-algebra classification remains open even for Lie algebras. This is supporting context, not a verbatim restatement of every quantifier in our conjecture.

opened_primary_results.source: Xin Fang, Non-symmetrizable quantum groups: defining ideals and specialization
opened_primary_results.claim: Quantum Nichols-algebra and specialization results, not a proof of the classical conjecture. The pre-screen attribution to Berenstein-Greenstein was incorrect.

opened_primary_results.source: Williams, Commutator Formulas in Groups of Kac-Moody Type
